title: Bandwidth Hog Identification
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog.
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=unifi:event
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(tx_bytes) as up_bytes, sum(rx_bytes) as down_bytes by hostname _time
| eval total_gb=round((up_bytes+down_bytes)/1073741824,2)
| stats avg(total_gb) as avg_daily_gb by hostname
| sort - avg_daily_gb
description: Ranks which devices use the most data each day, explaining a slow connection or a data-capped plan creeping toward its limit.
value: When the internet feels slow, the culprit is usually one device; ranking daily usage names it without guesswork.
implementation: Forward per-client traffic counters; schedule daily and review the heaviest users.
visualization: Bar chart of average daily data use by device.
grandmaExplanation: It shows which devices use the most internet data, explaining why things feel slow or your data cap is close.
